roles.name: EDUCATION_MANAGER
roles.description: Executive management with full visibility and governance over curriculum and quality.

roles.name: HEAD_OF_TRACK
roles.description: Track leader supervising instructor performance and evaluations within their domain.

roles.name: QA_TEAM
roles.description: Independent evaluation specialist conducting formal pedagogical & technical audits.

roles.name: INSTRUCTOR
roles.description: Classroom instructor receiving feedback, observations, and recommendations.

templates.name: Technical Observation Template
templates.description: Standardized evaluation metric for assessing technical mastery, live demonstration, and code problem solving.

templates.name: Non-Technical Observation Template
templates.description: Pedagogical evaluation framework for classroom management, student engagement, communication, and professionalism.

templateVersions.changeLog: Standard hierarchical technical evaluation rubric (Content Knowledge, Delivery, Engagement).
Standard pedagogical evaluation rubric (Delivery, Communication, Time Management).

mainCriteria.name: Content Knowledge
mainCriteria.description: Demonstrates deep mastery of architectural concepts, frameworks, and precision of explanations.

mainCriteria.name: Delivery & Communication
mainCriteria.description: Clarity, pacing, live demonstration competence, and technical communication.

mainCriteria.name: Student Engagement
mainCriteria.description: Active learning, student inquiry, troubleshooting scaffolding, and discussion facilitation.

mainCriteria.name: Pedagogical Delivery & Facilitation
mainCriteria.description: Classroom moderation, active learning structure, and instructional delivery.

mainCriteria.name: Communication & Empathy
mainCriteria.description: Vocal variety, listening, and constructive empathetic student rapport.

mainCriteria.name: Time & Classroom Management
mainCriteria.description: Punctuality, pacing, schedule adherence, and Q&A timeboxing.

subCriteria.name: Accuracy of Information
subCriteria.description: Presents correct syntax, algorithms, patterns, and bug-free logic with precision.

subCriteria.name: Depth of Explanation
subCriteria.description: Articulates underlying runtime mechanisms, memory considerations, and architectural trade-offs.

subCriteria.name: Use of Examples
subCriteria.description: Incorporates realistic production examples, concrete edge-cases, and relevant code patterns.

subCriteria.name: Clarity of Voice
subCriteria.description: Clear articulation, appropriate vocal variety, audible microphone volume, and precise terminology.

subCriteria.name: Pacing
subCriteria.description: Comfortable delivery speed allowing students to absorb code transitions and take notes.

subCriteria.name: Body Language
subCriteria.description: Engaged camera presence, open demeanor, and energetic instruction.

subCriteria.name: Asking Questions
subCriteria.description: Frequently checks for understanding using targeted questions and prompts.

subCriteria.name: Encouraging Discussion
subCriteria.description: Invites student questions, facilitates peer debugging, and validates alternative approaches.

subCriteria.name: Active Learning & Socratic Interaction
subCriteria.description: Uses participatory exercises and scaffolds student inquiry rather than passive lecturing.

subCriteria.name: Moderation & Discussion Flow
subCriteria.description: Manages chat questions, student turns, and breakout dynamics smoothly.

subCriteria.name: Vocal Variety & Clarity
subCriteria.description: Engaging tone, articulate phrasing, and accessible language.

subCriteria.name: Empathy & Constructive Demeanor
subCriteria.description: Validates student struggles and delivers supportive, growth-oriented feedback.

subCriteria.name: Punctuality & Agenda Adherence
subCriteria.description: Begins on time and follows a structured lesson agenda.

subCriteria.name: Q&A Buffer & Transition Management
subCriteria.description: Allocates dedicated question time without running over scheduled class finish.

criteria.name: Technical Knowledge & Architecture
criteria.description: Demonstrates deep mastery of architectural concepts, frameworks, and runtime mechanisms.

criteria.name: Content Accuracy & Code Quality
criteria.description: Presents correct syntax, algorithms, design patterns, and bug-free logic with precision.

criteria.name: Live Demonstration & Problem Solving
criteria.description: Executes live coding effectively, articulates trade-offs, and handles edge cases calmly.

criteria.name: Student Problem Solving Support
criteria.description: Patiently facilitates debugging strategies and scaffolds student thinking.

criteria.name: Technical Communication & Analogies
criteria.description: Translates complex low-level concepts into digestible analogies.

criteria.name: Communication Skills
criteria.description: Clear articulation, appropriate vocal variety and pacing, and active listening.

criteria.name: Student Engagement
criteria.description: Employs active learning, questioning, and reaches disengaged learners.

criteria.name: Classroom Management
criteria.description: Maintains an inclusive, respectful environment and moderates discussion flow.

criteria.name: Time Management
criteria.description: Starts and concludes punctually, paces lecture vs hands-on practice.

criteria.name: Professionalism
criteria.description: Preparedness, high-quality materials, empathetic rapport, and constructive tone.
